projects.title: Astrodex
projects.desc: AstroDex is an open-source interactive 3D Space Situational Awareness (SSA) dashboard that makes orbital mechanics and conjunction threat data accessible through a browser. It solves the problem of visualizing complex space debris risk in an engaging, real-time interface — useful for space enthusiasts, students, and developers. Built with Next.js 16 App Router, React Three Fiber, Three.js r184, and custom GLSL shaders, it features true Keplerian orbital propagation via Newton-Raphson solver, Vis-Viva speed equations, real-time 3D collision detection between 600 space objects and active satellites (ISS, Hubble, Envisat), LEO orbital decay simulation, cinematic Earth day/night GLSL shaders, and a WebGL-optimized dual InstancedMesh rendering 600 objects in just 2 draw calls.

projects.title: DoVER (Decentralized Official Vault & Evidence Registry)
projects.desc: DoVER (Decentralized Official Vault & Evidence Registry) is an AI-powered forensic ecosystem designed to eliminate digital document forgery. Unlike legacy systems that only check file hashes, DoVER implements a multi-layer "Security Intelligence" pipeline. Problem: Current verification systems can "hash a lie"—if a photoshopped file is uploaded, it is marked as "verified." Solution: DoVER uses TensorFlow-driven Pixel Forensics to detect physical tampering and Gemini to audit document content. Technical Approach: Every document is cryptographically fingerprinted (SHA-256), batched via Merkle Trees for scalability, and prepared for anchoring on the Polygon Blockchain. It features a multi-tenant architecture with strict isolation between Institutional (B2B) and Citizen (B2C) ledgers.

This project aims to solve that problem by creating a smart interview system that behaves like a real interviewer and provides instant AI-generated feedback, performance analysis, and improvement suggestions. The platform uses a composable AI pipeline approach, where multiple AI components work together to conduct adaptive interviews. Based on the user’s selected role, skill level, and previous performance, the system can dynamically generate questions, evaluate answers, analyze communication quality, and generate detailed reports. The project focuses on creating a complete end-to-end interview preparation ecosystem rather than just a static question-answer application. One of the key features of the platform is adaptive questioning. Instead of asking fixed questions, the AI can adjust the difficulty and topic of questions according to the candidate’s responses. For example, if a user performs well in Python basics, the system can automatically move toward advanced concepts such as APIs, machine learning, or system design. If the candidate struggles, the platform can provide easier questions and guidance to help them learn gradually. This creates a more personalized and realistic interview experience. The platform will support multiple interview categories, including technical interviews, HR interviews, behavioral interviews, coding interviews, aptitude rounds, and domain-specific interviews such as Data Science, Web Development, AI/ML, and Cloud Computing. Users will be able to select interview roles like Software Developer, Data Analyst, Machine Learning Engineer, Frontend Developer, Backend Developer, or Full Stack Developer. The system will then generate role-specific interview flows. Another important feature is audio-based interview interaction. Users can answer questions using either text or voice input. The AI system can analyze speech confidence, communication clarity, and response quality to generate insights that help candidates improve their communication skills. Future improvements may also include facial expression analysis, emotion detection, and multilingual interview support to make the platform more inclusive and accessible. After each interview session, the platform generates a detailed performance report. The report may include overall score, technical accuracy, communication quality, confidence level, topic-wise strengths and weaknesses, improvement suggestions, and recommended learning resources. This allows users to track their progress over time and focus on areas where they need improvement. Gamification features such as badges, streaks, rankings, and achievement systems can also be added to increase user engagement and motivation. The project is being developed using a modern full-stack architecture. The frontend is planned using React or Next.js to create a responsive and user-friendly interface. The backend will be developed using Python with Flask or FastAPI to handle APIs, AI workflows, authentication, and interview management. Databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL can be used for storing user data, interview history, reports, and analytics. AI functionalities will be powered using Natural Language Processing (NLP), Machine Learning models, speech processing tools, and external AI APIs where required. The project is designed with scalability and modularity in mind. Since it follows a composable AI architecture, contributors can independently improve different modules such as question generation, answer evaluation, analytics dashboard, speech analysis, frontend UI, authentication system, or deployment pipelines. This makes the project highly suitable for open-source collaboration because contributors from different domains can participate according to their interests and skill levels. As an open-source project, Composable-AI-Mock-Interviewer aims to create a beginner-friendly and collaborative environment for contributors. The repository will include proper documentation, setup instructions, contribution guidelines, issue labels, and mentorship support. Beginners can work on frontend enhancements, documentation, UI fixes, responsiveness, testing, and bug fixes, while advanced contributors can work on AI pipelines, backend optimization, deployment, and advanced analytics features. Issues will be categorized based on difficulty levels such as beginner, intermediate, and advanced to encourage participation from a diverse contributor community. The project also focuses on accessibility and inclusivity. Many students from smaller cities or non-technical backgrounds do not get opportunities to practice real interviews. By providing an AI-driven platform that is available online, the project can help bridge the gap between learning and industry expectations. The long-term vision is to create a smart career preparation assistant that supports interview preparation, resume analysis, career guidance, skill assessment, and personalized learning recommendations in one integrated platform. Through GSSoC, this project aims to build a strong open-source contributor community while creating a meaningful real-world application that can positively impact students and aspiring professionals. Contributors will gain experience in full-stack development, AI integration, open-source workflows, teamwork, GitHub collaboration, and real-world software engineering practices. The project not only solves a practical problem but also provides an excellent learning and contribution opportunity for developers interested in AI, software engineering, and open-source development.

projects.title: DBPortal
projects.desc: DBPortal is a powerful, local-first database explorer and schema visualizer designed for developers who need a unified interface to inspect multiple databases simultaneously. Unlike traditional heavy database management tools, DBPortal focuses on a streamlined, web-based experience for browsing records, understanding complex schema relationships, and running read-only queries. The project is built with a strictly read-only architecture, ensuring that users can safely explore production or development data without the risk of accidental mutations, deletions, or schema changes.

projects.title: Artery
projects.desc: Being someone who has multiple family members in the art business, the rise of AI generated art has created a large problem for artists. It's faster and cheaper than ever to produce visuals yet human artists are struggling more than ever to find their place and price their work fairly. Artery bridges this gap instead of widening it. Rather than replacing artists Artery uses AI as a communication tool where customers describe what they want, AI generates a reference visual and artists use that as a brief to create a real physical handcrafted piece. This eliminates the biggest friction in commissioned art which is the gap between what a customer imagines and what an artist delivers. Artery gives artists a clearer brief, fairer pricing power and a platform that positions human creativity to its deserved spot

projects.title: TermUI
projects.desc: TermUI is a TypeScript framework for building terminal applications. TermUI gives developers layout, JSX components with React-style hooks, file-based routing, state management, animations, theming, real-time system data, a hot-reload dev server, and project scaffolding. The project ships as a 13-package monorepo (pnpm + Turborepo): @termuijs/core (screen buffer, layout), @termuijs/jsx (JSX runtime, hooks), @termuijs/widgets (50+ widgets), @termuijs/ui (interactive components), @termuijs/tss (theming, 9 themes), @termuijs/store (global state), @termuijs/motion (animations), @termuijs/router (routing), @termuijs/data (CPU, memory, disk), @termuijs/quick (builder API), @termuijs/testing (test renderer), @termuijs/dev-server (hot reload), create-termui-app (scaffolding). TypeScript developers use TermUI to build CLI dashboards, AI chat interfaces, developer tools, admin panels, and system monitors.

projects.title: Flark.ai
projects.desc: FLARQ is an agentic job search operating system.

projects.title: Friends Hub
projects.desc: Friends-Hub is a full-stack social media platform solving the need for a secure, scalable, and real-time connected social experience. Built for developers and end-users alike, it supports posts, stories, comments, likes, follows, real-time chat, group messaging, and instant notifications. Technically, it uses Spring Boot 3 with JWT authentication, role-based access control, WebSocket for real-time features, and Resilience4j circuit breakers for reliability. The backend exposes a hardened REST API with distributed rate limiting (60 req/min/IP), Prometheus metrics, and API telemetry. Media is handled via Supabase Storage. The React 18 frontend uses Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion for a smooth dark-mode UI. Containerized with Docker for consistent deployment.

projects.title: Devception
projects.desc: A real-time multiplayer coding game for programmers — combining collaborative code editing with social deduction mechanics inspired by Among Us. Work together to fix a shared codebase, complete tasks, and root out the hidden imposter before time runs out. Devception puts 4–8 players in a shared coding environment. Most players are Good Coders — they must collaboratively solve a complex coding problem and complete individual mini-tasks. Hidden among them are Imposters who try to sabotage progress through bug injection, screen blurring, and misleading hints — all while pretending to help. When things get suspicious, any player can call an Emergency Meeting to discuss and vote out the imposter. The game ends when the code is complete, the imposter is voted out, or time expires.

projects.title: Secdev
projects.desc: Autonomous Cloud Deployment & Security Platform Deploy, Test & Pen-Test in Isolated Sandboxes A self-learning, self-adaptive security-first deployment platform with autonomous security scanning, AI-assisted attack pipelines, and real-time monitoring. SecDev is a cloud-native autonomous deployment platform that enables developers to deploy any Git repository into isolated E2B sandbox environments with one click, then immediately run comprehensive security, performance, and penetration tests against the live deployment.

projects.title: Recovera
projects.desc: Recovera is an AI-assisted SRE platform designed for engineering teams to automate the manual, fatiguing process of incident investigation and remediation. By transforming raw production signals into actionable workflows, it significantly reduces downtime and operational overhead. The technical approach involves an event-driven pipeline that normalizes log streams through AWS Firehose, utilizes LLMs for intelligent root-cause analysis correlated with git history, and generates validated code fixes. These fixes are safety-gated by a robust policy engine and automatically delivered as reviewable Pull Requests, ensuring a secure, automated path from anomaly detection to verified production resolution.

projects.title: Gaprio
projects.desc: Gaprio is an open-source AI workflow orchestration platform designed to solve the problem of unsafe, disjointed AI automation. Most AI agents execute tasks blindly; Gaprio introduces a "Human-in-the-Loop" (HITL) safety layer, ensuring agents pause for human approval before taking critical actions like sending reports or modifying databases. It is built for enterprises looking to implement safe, reliable agentic workflows. Technically, Gaprio is a Python monorepo that uses LangGraph to orchestrate state-machine-based multi-agent workflows, ChromaDB for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) registry for executing external tools. The backend is powered by FastAPI.

projects.title: WebEl
projects.desc: OpenDeploy is a beautiful, brutalist-inspired Next.js + Go dashboard designed to turn any linux device into a self-hosted platform-as-a-service (PaaS). No terminal or SSH needed—just plug it in, hit the dashboard, and deploy your apps directly from GitHub via Cloudflare Tunnels.

projects.title: ai-audit-shelf
projects.desc: ai-audit-shelf solves the challenge of assessing AI models for fairness, bias, and reliability. Many developers and organizations lack easy-to-use tools for auditing and documenting machine learning models. This project is for students, data scientists, and AI practitioners who want to ensure their models are ethical and transparent. Our technical approach includes open-source Python modules that automate model evaluation, bias detection, and reporting. The toolkit integrates with popular ML frameworks (like scikit-learn and TensorFlow) so contributors can run audits, generate standardized reports, and visualize results—all while learning through beginner-friendly issues and clear docs.

projects.title: WiseMindOS
projects.desc: WiseMindOS is a full-stack productivity and life-management platform designed to help users transform long-term goals into structured daily execution through interconnected planning systems, habit tracking, productivity analytics, and focused workflows. Unlike traditional productivity applications that focus only on isolated task management, WiseMindOS connects goals, projects, tasks, habits, daily planning, focus systems, and analytics into a unified productivity ecosystem. The platform currently includes goal management, project tracking, solo task management, daily planner, habit tracking, productivity dashboard, focus room, notebook/library system, JWT-based authentication, and productivity analytics. WiseMindOS is built using the MERN stack with modular backend architecture and scalable frontend components. The long-term vision is to evolve into a complete Life Operating System with FutureTwin, an AI-powered personalized productivity assistant.

projects.title: RepoReaper
projects.desc: RepoReaper is a full-stack GitHub productivity platform that helps developers manage their repositories and starred repositories efficiently. It allows users to bulk delete, archive, and privatize repositories, as well as bulk unstar repositories they no longer need. The project uses secure GitHub OAuth authentication and follows a stateless architecture, ensuring that no user data or tokens are permanently stored. It is designed with a modern React-based frontend and a Node.js backend, making it an excellent project for contributors interested in full-stack development, API integration, authentication, and UI/UX improvements.

projects.title: Truxify
projects.desc: Truxify is an open-source, broker-free freight marketplace for India that directly connects manufacturers and truck drivers — eliminating the 30-40% broker commission that currently eats into driver earnings. The platform uses ML-powered bilateral load-to-truck matching, 3D bin packing for multi-customer load optimisation, real-time GPS tracking via WebSockets, UPI escrow payments via Polygon smart contracts, Digilocker-based document verification, and a Voice AI agent for customer shipment queries. Built with Flutter (driver + customer apps), Node.js + Express (main API), FastAPI (ML serving), PostgreSQL + PostGIS (geospatial queries), MongoDB (GPS logs), n8n automation for dispute resolution, and blockchain-based driver reputation. Targeting India's 1.4 crore registered trucks and the small manufacturers and single truck owners that every existing platform ignores.

projects.title: OMNYX
projects.desc: OMNYX solves the problem of invisible digital surveillance and overwhelming privacy complexity. Most users today have little visibility into how apps access permissions, track behavior, collect background data, or interact with sensitive device systems in realtime. Existing privacy tools are often passive, technical, or fragmented across settings menus that users rarely understand or actively monitor. OMNYX is designed for privacy-conscious users, AI-native consumers, and people who want a more intelligent and adaptive approach to digital security rather than traditional antivirus-style software. Technically, OMNYX combines realtime threat simulation, behavioral analysis, adaptive UI systems, and AI-generated intelligence summaries into a mobile-first operating environment. The system includes: * realtime threat feeds * AI swarm coordination * replay memory streams * adaptive operating modes * AI explanation engines * atmospheric system states The frontend is built using React Native and Expo with animated cinematic UI systems, realtime environmental rendering, and modular intelligence components. The backend architecture uses secure AI proxy patterns for operational analysis generation while maintaining trust boundaries and API isolation. A major part of the project was also exploring AI-native interaction design specifically how future interfaces might evolve from static dashboards into adaptive, operational environments that continuously interpret and respond to realtime conditions.

projects.title: Quelltest
projects.desc: Most test tools optimize for coverage %. A test can cover a line without verifying anything. quelltest fixes this. It reads Pydantic Field validators, Literal types, docstring Raises: blocks, and if/raise guard clauses directly from AST. For each gap, two-phase verification runs: test must pass on original code, then fail when the requirement is deliberately violated. If a test passes on broken code, it gets rejected. Rule engine handles 75% of cases with zero LLM calls — nothing leaves your machine. GitHub Action scans PRs for untested guards and posts inline annotations automatically. Built for Python developers who want tests that actually catch bugs, not just pass.

projects.title: Boi Para
projects.desc: Boi Para is a MERN stack web application focused on buying and selling old books online. The platform helps students and readers sell unused books and buy second-hand books at affordable prices. The main problem it solves is the difficulty of finding affordable used books and the lack of a proper platform for selling old books easily. Instead of searching through local markets or social media groups, users can directly list and browse books on the website. The application was built using React.js for the frontend and Node.js with Express.js for the backend. MongoDB was used for storing user and book data. The project includes features like user authentication, adding book listings, searching books, viewing book details, and managing uploaded books through REST APIs.

projects.title: Mess food feedback analyzer
projects.desc: Mess Food Feedback Analyzer is a machine learning-based project developed using Python to analyze and predict mess food ratings based on various factors such as food quality, cleanliness, quantity, and taste. The project aims to help understand student satisfaction by converting feedback data into meaningful insights through data analysis and prediction models. The system uses libraries like Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Scikitlearn for data processing, visualization, and model training. Linear Regression is implemented to predict overall food ratings based on user input parameters. The project also includes data preprocessing, feature selection, and visualization techniques to improve analysis and understand trends in feedback data. This project demonstrates practical applications of machine learning, data analysis, and predictive modeling in solving real-world problems. It also reflects skills in Python programming, handling datasets, and building beginner-friendly AI/ML solutions.

projects.title: EaseMotion CSS
projects.desc: EaseMotion CSS is a human-readable, animation-first CSS framework designed to make UI development more expressive and beginner-friendly. Instead of cryptic utility classes, EaseMotion uses descriptive class names like `ease-center`, `ease-fade-in`, and `ease-hover-grow`. The project focuses on readability, motion design, composability, and zero-dependency usage. Contributors submit raw HTML/CSS animation ideas through a curated contribution pipeline, which are then reviewed, standardized, and integrated into the framework. The project includes utilities, animations, components, documentation, and contributor onboarding structure.

projects.title: Herflow
projects.desc: A privacy-first, Al-powered women's health PWA focused on gentle cycle tracking, emotional wellbeing, and safe community support.

projects.title: Ageix
projects.desc: Ageix is an AI-powered one-click truth detector designed to help users identify fake news, phishing links, scams, and misleading online content quickly and easily. The project aims to improve digital safety for everyday internet users by analyzing text and URLs using machine learning and intelligent detection techniques. It is built using modern web technologies and AI models to provide fast, user-friendly, and reliable verification of suspicious content.

projects.title: Beamsync
projects.desc: BeamSync addresses the frustration of slow, internet-dependent file transfers. It's a peer-to-peer file transfer protocol designed for modern workflows—completely offline, directly over your LAN. Built with Go and Svelte, it combines technical robustness with an immersive cyberpunk interface, offering users fast transfers, automatic network detection, drag-and-drop support, and seamless mobile device pairing via QR codes. Perfect for teams, creators, and anyone who needs to move large files instantly without external dependencies

projects.title: CognitiveSB
projects.desc: What problem does it solve: Traditional study tools are passive — you read, highlight, and hope it sticks. The real problem is that passive consumption doesn't build understanding. Students need to be challenged, questioned, and tested on their material — not just given a summary of it. Existing tools like NotebookLM let you chat with documents but don't actively teach you. ShadowByte fixes this by forcing active recall through four distinct pedagogical modes, automated quizzes, and spaced repetition flashcards — all generated directly from your own study material. Who is it for: Students and self-learners who upload their own material — lecture notes, research papers, textbooks, or YouTube lectures — and want to actually understand it, not just read it again. Specifically useful for exam preparation, learning technical topics, and anyone who learns better through conversation and testing than through passive reading. Technical approach: ShadowByte ingests PDFs, DOCX, TXT files, and YouTube transcripts through a loader manager that normalizes all sources into text chunks. Those chunks are embedded using HuggingFace sentence-transformers and stored in a FAISS vector index. At query time, a LangGraph RAG workflow retrieves the most relevant chunks, reranks them, and streams a response via SSE using Groq-hosted LLMs. Four system prompt templates switch the LLM's behavior between Socratic tutoring, Feynman mode, simple explanation, and exam preparation. All session data, message history, flashcard schedules, and quiz scores are persisted in SQLite using a custom SM-2 spaced repetition implementation. The frontend is React with TypeScript, displaying an interactive knowledge graph built from NLP relationship extraction on the ingested content.

projects.title: SuperBrowser
projects.desc: SuperBrowser is an AI-powered unified browsing platform built by me and Prince Patel to solve fragmentation in modern internet workflows. Users constantly switch between search engines for SEO, AI platforms for reasoning, and community platforms like Reddit or StackOverflow for validation, repeatedly losing context. SuperBrowser introduces a shared Context Window that tracks user activity during a session. When switching to SuperAI mode, the context can be passed with one click, allowing the AI to instantly understand the workflow without repeated explanations. The platform consists of SuperSEO, SuperAI, and SuperReview. SuperSEO uses SerpAPI with scraper fallbacks, SuperAI uses Grok API with system-prompt alignment, and SuperReview extracts community-driven insights using custom scrapers and sentiment analysis.

projects.title: TAKE ONE Nexus
projects.desc: TAKE ONE Nexus is the definitive digital ecosystem for the next generation of filmmakers, screenwriters, and creative technocrats. We noticed a major Problem: student filmmakers and independent creatives often struggle to find dedicated, skilled crew members for their passion projects. Our Solution: A platform designed with a cinematic "Director-style" aesthetic that acts as a secure, real-time hub for showcasing portfolios, discovering talent based on creative roles, and forming production crews.

projects.title: Drift Seek
projects.desc: DriftSeeker is an Autonomous DevSecOps Control Plane engineered to manage the complete lifecycle of cloud incident response. It operates as a unified, zero-trust internal developer portal, replacing fragmented infrastructure tools with a single high-velocity dashboard. ​The system architecture is divided into five isolated modules: ​1.Uptime Monitoring: A continuous network evaluation engine utilizing Redis and WebSockets to deliver real-time, low-latency alerting. ​2.Drift Detection: An automated reconciliation pipeline that flags unauthorized configuration changes by comparing live Docker container states against official GitHub repositories. ​3.Ephemeral Web Shell: A browser-based terminal running on minimal Alpine Linux. It provides instant remediation access and enforces a zero-trust teardown protocol by committing session state to an archive branch before container annihilation. ​4.Automated Verification: Jenkins integration to benchmark and stress-test manual hotfixes in isolated environments before source control integration. ​5.AI Security Auditing: A decoupled, serverless Genkit pipeline executing deep logic vulnerability scans on isolated GCP infrastructure to protect the main event loop. ​Built to maximize efficiency, DriftSeeker embraces digital minimalism, leveraging decoupled cloud-native execution to deliver enterprise-grade system resilience without infrastructure bloat.

projects.title: OCTO CLAW
projects.desc: Code Companion is a browser-based, AI-powered integrated development environment (IDE) designed for writing, running, and debugging code in real-time. It provides a lightweight, accessible coding platform that works across all major operating systems without requiring local setup.

projects.title: CodeGraphContext
projects.desc: An MCP server plus a CLI tool that indexes local code into a graph database to provide context to AI assistants.

projects.title: Green vehicle
projects.desc: This project is a modern green mobility awareness and lead-generation website developed for Elicnet under Media Day. The platform focuses on comparing Petrol and Electric Vehicles by highlighting the benefits, efficiency, and sustainability of EVs through an interactive and visually engaging experience. I developed a fully responsive website with smooth animations, modern UI/UX, and optimized performance to improve user engagement across all devices. The website also includes lead collection features and stall booking functionality for events and exhibitions, helping businesses connect with potential customers effectively.

projects.title: TRX
projects.desc: TRX is a highly efficient, terminal-based (TUI) package manager written in the Rust programming language. TRX is designed to solve the problem of inefficient package management by offering a highly efficient way of working with packages via a low-overhead, safe API. The technical idea behind TRX is based on manual memory management and zero-cost abstractions. This enables TRX to offer extremely fast dependency analysis and a highly efficient CLI experience.

projects.title: Uplyft-AI
projects.desc: Uplyft AI is a full-stack AI career platform that takes you from resume upload to interview-ready — automatically. Upload your resume once and everything personalises: your ATS score, skill gaps, career roadmap, mock interviews, and learning plan — all generated from your actual data, not templates. What it solves: Most job seekers get rejected without knowing why. Uplyft fixes that with honest, data-driven feedback at every step. Key features: 📄 Resume Analyzer — ATS score, keyword gaps, fix suggestions 📊 Skill Gap Analysis — color-coded: present, missing, partial 🗺️ Career Roadmap — 5-phase personalized plan 🎙️ Mock Interviews — scored, timed, with model answers 📚 Learning Tracker — maps gaps to real courses 🐙 Portfolio Analyzer — GitHub stats, no login needed Built for students, freshers, and career switchers who need real answers — not generic advice. One upload. Every insight.

projects.title: optiqor-cli
projects.desc: Optiqor CLI solves the problem of slow and infrastructure-heavy Kubernetes cost analysis by providing instant insights directly from Helm charts and manifests without requiring cluster access, agents, Prometheus, or telemetry. It is designed for SREs, platform engineers, DevOps teams, and Kubernetes developers who need fast feedback during CI/CD reviews and infrastructure optimization workflows. The project automates critical SRE operations by detecting cloud cost inefficiencies, unsafe Kubernetes configurations, scaling risks, and operational anti-patterns before workloads reach production. This helps teams reduce cloud waste, improve reliability, strengthen security posture, and accelerate deployment confidence. Technically, the project is built in Go using a deterministic rule-engine architecture that parses Helm charts into normalized workload models and runs multiple cost, security, and optimization detectors to generate actionable findings within seconds.

projects.title: Amrit Sathi
projects.desc: Travel planning and group navigation are often fragmented and rely heavily on constant internet connectivity. Amrit Sathi solves this by providing a persistent, contextual travel brain that helps users plan, navigate, and stay connected with their squad, even offline. It is built for solo backpackers, travel groups, and explorers venturing into low-network areas. Our technical approach utilizes an offline-first architecture built natively in Flutter/Dart, backed by Hive for local NoSQL storage. We integrate the Google Gemini AI engine (google_generative_ai) to serve as a hyper-contextual travel copilot. During GSSoC, we are actively evolving from local data vaults to a robust cloud infrastructure using FastAPI (Python) for AI orchestration and Supabase (PostgreSQL + PostGIS) for spatial data and real-time squad synchronization, preparing the app for a secure Play Store launch.

projects.title: KartMe
projects.desc: KartMe is a modern full-stack MERN ecommerce platform inspired by quick-commerce applications like Blinkit. The application delivers a complete online shopping experience with secure authentication, product management, cart functionality, online payments, order tracking, and an admin dashboard. Built using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js), KartMe follows a scalable architecture with separate frontend and backend services, making it suitable for both learning and production-grade deployment.

projects.title: JESS
projects.desc: Jess AI is an Assistive Autonomous AI System designed to bridge digital intelligence with real-world interaction through a physical AI platform called the Jess Bot. Unlike traditional chatbots that exist only on screens, Jess AI is being developed as a context-aware AI assistant capable of understanding its environment, interacting with users naturally, and performing autonomous assistance tasks using sensors, embedded systems, computer vision, voice interaction, and automation modules. The project focuses on giving AI “world awareness” by combining software intelligence with physical perception. Jess Bot acts as the embodiment of Jess AI, allowing the system to perceive surroundings, respond to environmental changes, navigate interactions, and assist users in real-world scenarios. The long-term goal is to build an open, extensible assistive AI ecosystem that can support education, accessibility, smart environments, research, productivity, and human-centered automation. The project is designed to be modular so contributors can work on AI models, embedded systems, robotics, web dashboards, APIs, automation workflows, UI/UX, or perception systems independently. Technically, the system combines AI/ML modules, real-time sensor integration, embedded controllers, web technologies, automation systems, and physical computing. Future development includes memory systems, contextual understanding, autonomous task execution, environment mapping, and multi-device interaction. This project is intended to evolve into a publicly useful assistive technology platform rather than a personal gadget, enabling developers, students, researchers, and makers to collaboratively build accessible real-world AI systems.

projects.title: QuantNova
projects.desc: QuantNova is an open-source GUI-based quantitative backtesting platform designed to make algorithmic trading workflows more accessible, visual, and contributor-friendly. The project bridges the gap between code-heavy frameworks like Backtrader and closed platforms like TradingView by combining modern charting, modular strategy development, and open-source extensibility. Users can upload OHLCV datasets or fetch data from APIs such as Binance and Yahoo Finance, apply indicators, build strategies, and run backtests through a modern web interface. Tech stack: • Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS • Backend: FastAPI, Python, WebSockets • Quant stack: Pandas, NumPy, TA-Lib • Infrastructure: Docker, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions Planned features include candlestick charts, drawing tools, indicator libraries, strategy builder UI, analytics dashboard, and modular plugin support.

The platform supports automated candidate screening, structured evaluations, resume analysis, and AI-driven feedback generation. Built using a microservices and event-driven architecture with technologies like Kafka, FastApi, PostgreSQL, and LangChain, InterXAI is designed to handle scalable concurrent interviews efficiently.

projects.title: Late-Meet
projects.desc: Late-Meet is a modern meeting and collaboration platform focused on improving productivity and simplifying virtual communication workflows. The project helps users organize meetings, collaborate efficiently, and manage communication in a seamless way. The platform is currently under active development with ongoing improvements in audio capture, real-time communication, UI/UX, and workflow stability. Future plans include AI-assisted productivity features, smart scheduling, and enhanced collaboration tools. Late-Meet is designed as an open-source project where contributors can work on frontend development, backend APIs, authentication, bug fixing, performance optimization, accessibility, and feature enhancements. projects.title: ZerithDB

The project focuses on simplicity, performance, and real-world usability with developer-friendly APIs.

projects.title: KampusKart
projects.desc: KampusKart is an open-source campus marketplace platform that helps students buy, sell, rent, or exchange items within their college community. It is designed for students who need an easy and trusted way to find books, electronics, hostel essentials, notes, and other useful items without relying on scattered WhatsApp groups or informal contacts.

projects.title: Adiuvare
projects.desc: Adiuvare is an open source API security middleware. It features a dual track async processing pipeline for per request threat analysis across five dimensions including SQL injection cross site scripting ReDoS IP reputation and behavioral pattern scoring. It is designed for non blocking high throughput backend environments. I designed a plug and play middleware interface enabling integration with FastAPI Flask and Django through a minimal configuration.

projects.title: Wazpay
projects.desc: WazPay is a specialized Android application designed to automate offline UPI payment flows using the USSD *99# infrastructure. By leveraging Android Accessibility Services, the app provides a hands free experience for mobile banking without internet connectivity. This solution is ideal for users in low connectivity areas or those seeking a reliable backup to data dependent payment apps.

projects.title: StackIt - Professional Q&A Platform
projects.desc: StackIt is a full-stack Q&A platform inspired by Stack Overflow, designed to enable collaborative knowledge sharing. It allows users to ask questions, post answers, vote on content, and accept the best solutions. The platform features secure JWT-based authentication, a rich text editor with markdown support, tag-based categorization, and advanced search and filtering. It also includes a reputation system, real-time notifications using WebSockets, and detailed user profiles. projects.title: Autonomous Recovery Controller (ARC)
projects.desc: Training of neural networks frequently fails. After 48 hours, a NaN gradient occurs and the training must be restarted. Computational time, GPU budget, sleepless nights and for what? There is no effective solution available. The ARC (Autonomous Recovery Controller) is the first autonomous fail-safe system for training neural networks. Simply add three lines to the training loop and the controller will monitor more than 12 signals including the gradient norm, the loss trend, the model weights and the optimizer states. ARC detects failure modes with an accuracy of 97.5% using a lightweight MLP classifier. If a problem arises, the system automatically performs a rollback to the last healthy checkpoint and makes necessary corrections. We tested the system on 25 different failure modes and demonstrated perfect recovery without any false alarms on models from 20k to 117M parameters (GPT-2, ResNet-50, ViT). The overhead is below 10% for all models except for the smallest MLP.

Labels the PR automatically (ai-slop:high/medium/low) 2. Posts 3 comprehension questions only the real author could answer 3. Writes a draft code review for the maintainer 4. Detects and rate-limits PR flood attacks

projects.title: Telos Runtime
projects.desc: Telos Runtime closes the security gap in autonomous AI agent deployments. Telos solves this at the kernel level using eBPF/LSM hooks. Agents declare intent in natural language. Telos translates this to kernel policy via the Cortex AI plane and enforces it at Ring 0. If an agent reads /etc/shadow and attempts a network connection, the kernel permanently slams the network gate before a single byte leaves the machine. projects.title: SnapPass-AI
projects.desc: What problem does it solve? It solves the time-consuming manual workflow in photo studios where photographers must individually crop, resize, center faces, remove backgrounds, adjust passport dimensions, arrange multiple copies on an A4 sheet, and prepare the image for printing. This process usually takes 15–20 minutes per customer. The system automates the entire workflow in seconds, reducing time, manual effort, and human error while improving print accuracy and consistency. Who is it for? It is designed for photo studios, passport and visa photo centers, cyber cafes, local print shops, photographers, document service centers, and customers who need instant passport-size or ID photos. It is especially useful for small businesses that handle large numbers of customers and need fast turnaround time. What is the technical approach? React frontend + Express backend + Python AI for auto face centering, background removal, resize, and A4 print generation.

projects.title: SyncMind
projects.desc: SyncMind is an AI-powered meeting intelligence platform that automatically converts raw meeting audio into structured outputs such as summaries, action items, and key insights. It solves the problem of unstructured conversations by eliminating manual note-taking and making meetings searchable and actionable. The system is designed for students, teams, and professionals who want to retain and utilize meeting knowledge efficiently. Technically, it uses an event-driven architecture where audio uploads trigger AWS Lambda workflows that process speech via AWS Transcribe and generate insights using large language models on Amazon Bedrock, with results stored in DynamoDB and displayed through a React-based dashboard. The system is currently being extended to support real-time transcription and conversational querying for live meeting intelligence.

projects.title: EXECRA
projects.desc: The system solves the problem that people struggle during execution of tasks despite having access to information, due to lack of real-time, context-aware guidance. Instead of the inefficient cycle of searching, learning, and then applying, it assists users while they are actively performing tasks, reducing errors, time waste, and cognitive load. It is designed for students, professionals, and everyday users handling coding, software, and real-world tasks like forms, repairs, or daily activities. Technically, it is a multimodal AI system that uses screen input for digital tasks, camera input for physical tasks, and combines code execution tracking, computer vision, OCR, and AI reasoning to understand context, monitor actions continuously, detect errors, predict outcomes, and provide step-by-step guidance with explanations and confidence levels in real time.

projects.title: Pathfinder AI
projects.desc: PathFinder AI is an intelligent web application that helps you craft professional resumes, write tailored cover letters, and prepare for interviews all powered by AI. Whether you're launching your career or making your next big move, Pathfinder is your personalized guide.

projects.title: UIverse
projects.desc: UIverse is an open-source React-based UI component library designed to help developers build modern web applications faster with reusable and customizable components. The project focuses on simplicity, clean design, and ease of contribution, making it ideal for beginners and experienced developers to collaborate. UIverse includes a growing collection of components such as buttons, cards, navbars, forms, and more, all built using React and CSS. This project is GSSoC-ready and encourages contributors to add new components, improve UI/UX, enhance performance, and expand the library. With a structured and beginner-friendly codebase, UIverse aims to become a community-driven platform for sharing and building high-quality UI components. Key highlights: * Reusable and customizable React components * Beginner-friendly open-source project * Clean and scalable architecture * Easy contribution process * Continuous expansion through community contributions

projects.title: KrishiSetu
projects.desc: KrishiSetu is a blockchain-powered supply chain traceability application that enables farmers, distributors, and consumers to track agricultural products from farm to table. The platform provides product registration, QR code generation, scanning capabilities, and comprehensive supply chain visualization with blockchain verification. The application uses a modern full-stack architecture with React frontend, Express.js backend, MongoDB database, and Firebase authentication. It's designed to provide transparency and trust in agricultural supply chains through immutable blockchain records and user-friendly interfaces.

projects.title: ms-ui-kit
projects.desc: ms-ui-kit is a reusable and customizable React UI component library designed to simplify the process of building modern web applications. It solves the problem of repetitive UI development by providing a set of pre-built, consistent, and accessible components such as buttons, cards, modals, navigation elements, and more. This project is ideal for frontend developers, students, and startups who want to accelerate development while maintaining clean and scalable UI architecture. Technically, the library is built using React with Vite for fast bundling and TailwindCSS for utility-first styling. It follows a modular component-based architecture, allowing easy integration and extensibility. The project also focuses on performance, reusability, and developer experience, with plans to improve accessibility, documentation, and component coverage through open-source contributions.

projects.title: Learnova
projects.desc: Learnova is an AI-integrated education platform designed to streamline curriculum planning, attendance management, and personalized learning. It provides role-based dashboards for students, teachers, and admins, along with real-time collaboration and AI-driven insights. Built using Next.js, MongoDB, and modern web technologies, it focuses on scalability, performance, and seamless academic management.

projects.title: CropChain
projects.desc: CropChain is a full-stack blockchain-based web application that enables transparent and secure tracking of agricultural produce across the entire supply chain from farmers to consumers using smart contracts, QR codes, and real-time updates to ensure trust, traceability, and efficiency.

projects.title: SafeVoice
projects.desc: SafeVoice, an AI-powered anonymous support platform, by enhancing multi-language translation (8+ Indian languages) and real-time grammar correction using Google Gemini AI via Firebase Cloud Functions, improving frontend UI/UX in React & Tailwind CSS, optimizing Firestore queries, implementing secure anonymous CRUD operations.

projects.title: Repo-lyzer
projects.desc: Repo-lyzer solves the problem of understanding and evaluating code repositories quickly and effectively. Developers often struggle to assess project quality, activity, and maintainability across multiple repos. Repo-lyzer analyzes metrics like commits, issues, pull requests, and contributor patterns to provide clear insights. It helps teams make informed decisions, identify strong projects, and improve their own repositories by highlighting gaps, trends, and performance indicators in a simple, actionable dashboard for faster onboarding, collaboration, and smarter open source and internal project management workflows.

projects.title: Link ID - Professional Identity Router
projects.desc: LinkID is a professional identity routing platform that solves the problem of sharing long, inconsistent, and hard-to-remember URLs across different platforms. Developers and professionals often need to share multiple links (GitHub, LinkedIn, portfolio, etc.), which creates friction in resumes, forms, and networking. LinkID simplifies this by allowing users to create a single username and map it to all their platforms, generating clean, predictable URLs like /username/github or /username/linkedin. These links are stable and can be updated anytime without changing the public URL. The platform is built using Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Prisma, and PostgreSQL. It includes features like platform auto-detection, URL validation, secure authentication via NextAuth, and a real-time dashboard for managing links. The routing system dynamically resolves usernames and redirects to the correct destination efficiently.

projects.title: Payshield-AIOPS
projects.desc: PayShield AI is a real-time fraud detection platform built for digital payment systems. It solves the growing problem of sophisticated financial fraud — account takeovers, transaction laundering, and fraud rings — that traditional rule-based systems miss. Built for fintech developers and security teams, it uses an ensemble of ML models (XGBoost, BiLSTM, Graph Neural Networks) combined with behavioral analytics and blockchain audit logging to score every transaction instantly and explainably. The system is modular and fault-tolerant, so it keeps running even when individual services go down.

projects.title: Github Tracker
projects.desc: A web app designed to help you monitor and analyze the activity of GitHub users. Whether you’re a developer, a project manager, or just curious, this tool simplifies tracking contributions and activity across repositories

projects.title: Editron
projects.desc: Editron is a browser-based Al-powered code editor designed to bring a full development environment to the web. Built using Next.js, TypeScript, and WebContainers, it allows users to write, run, and manage code entirely in the browser with no local setup. It features a Monaco-based editor with IntelliSense, multi-file support, and an integrated terminal for real command execution. A key highlight is its Al assistant, which can read, generate, and modify project files directly, enabling faster development workflows. Editron also supports GitHub import (including monorepos), OAuth-based authentication, and persistent project storage. The goal of Editron is to make coding more accessible, collaborative, and Al-augmented, especially for learners and developers who want a powerful, zero-setup development experience.

projects.title: medInternia
projects.desc: MedInternia is a comprehensive medical education and collaboration platform designed for doctors, interns, and patients. It provides a rich set of features for case-based learning, certifications, job opportunities, webinars, and more.

projects.title: ElderEase – AI-Powered Remote Health Monitoring System
projects.desc: ElderEase is an AI-powered remote health monitoring system designed to help families and caregivers track the health and safety of elderly individuals in real time. The project aims to solve the problem of delayed medical attention and lack of continuous monitoring for senior citizens, especially those living alone. It provides features like real-time vitals tracking, risk detection, alerts, and a connected dashboard for caregivers. Technically, the system combines a full-stack web application with AI/ML models to analyze health data and detect anomalies. The frontend is built using modern frameworks, while the backend handles data processing, APIs, and real-time updates. The AI component focuses on predicting potential health risks and generating alerts. The project is designed to be beginner-friendly for contributors, with modular features like UI improvements, API integrations, data visualization, and ML model enhancements.

projects.title: ML-CaPsule
projects.desc: ML-Capsule is a project designed for beginners and experienced data science enthusiasts who lack proper mentorship but want to learn Machine Learning. It provides hands-on learning through real-world projects covering ML, DL, Generative AI, and Agentic AI, helping users build practical skills and become interview-ready. The platform also focuses on automated workflow generation, enabling learners to design intelligent systems and end-to-end AI-driven solutions

projects.title: GitGenie
projects.desc: GitGenie is an intelligent command-line interface (CLI) tool designed to simplify and automate Git workflows. It handles common Git operations like committing, branch management, staging, and pushing, while optionally integrating AI-generated commit messages using Google Gemini.

projects.title: CruxCRM
projects.desc: CruxCRM is a Customer Relation Management tool built using React.js, Springboot and PostgreSQL. The project consists of basic features like CRUD operations but its interoperability is not so good. The project needs smart AI integration, user tracking and much more.

projects.title: ZentureWellness
projects.desc: ZentureWellness is a full-stack mental wellness platform designed specifically for college students to access counseling, peer support, and self-help resources in one place. Many students struggle with mental health issues but lack accessible and structured support systems. This project solves that problem by providing features like appointment booking with counselors, community support, self-assessment tools, and educational content. The platform is built using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for the frontend, with a Node.js backend, REST APIs, and PostgreSQL database. It also includes JWT-based authentication and role-based access for admins, counselors, and users.

projects.title: YTM Miniplayer
projects.desc: A lightweight, distraction-free mini-player extension for YouTube Music, available for Firefox and Chrome.YouTube Music is great, but managing playback while coding or studying often means hunting through dozens of open tabs. projects.title: RustTune – Music Streaming App in Rust
projects.desc: RustTune is a modern music streaming application built using Rust, focused on performance, safety, and scalability. The project aims to demonstrate how Rust can be used beyond systems programming to build real-world web applications. It solves the problem of limited beginner-friendly Rust projects by providing an open-source platform where developers can learn Rust through practical implementation. The application will include features such as music playback, playlist management, and search functionality. This project is designed for developers who want to explore Rust in web development. The technical approach includes using Rust for backend development (with frameworks like Actix Web or Rocket) and a simple frontend using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The codebase will be modular and well-documented to ensure easy onboarding for contributors.

projects.title: Skill Issue
projects.desc: Skill Issue(skillissue.bajpai.tech) is a marketplace for .md skill files, instructions that tell AI agents exactly how to behave for a task. Browse and download skills from Anthropic, Vercel, OpenAI, and HuggingFace (fetched live from GitHub), or build your own by just describing what you want. Non-technical users copy-paste into ChatGPT or Claude Projects. Developers drop the folder into their agents directory. Built with React + Vite + Tailwind, Appwrite for auth and storage, Groq (Llama 4 Scout + Llama 3.3 70B) for skill generation.

projects.title: StudyMatePlus
projects.desc: StudyMatePlus is an open-source platform designed to help college students access academic resources like syllabus, previous year question papers (PYQs), notes, and exam feedback in one place. It also allows students to connect with seniors for guidance and doubt solving. The project was successfully part of GSSoC 2025, where contributors worked on improving UI, fixing bugs, and adding new features. The platform uses React/Next.js for frontend and Node.js with MongoDB/Firebase for backend. The goal is to make a simple, organized, and student-friendly resource hub for exam preparation.

projects.title: GSoC-Org-Finder-
projects.desc: GSoC 2026 Org Finder is a high-performance tool designed to help students navigate the 185+ organizations selected for Google Summer of Code. Identifying the right org based on tech stack, competition level, and activity is often overwhelming for beginners; this project simplifies that discovery with a fast, searchable interface and live GitHub metrics. Who is it for? It is primarily for GSoC aspirants and open-source newcomers who need a data-driven way to find projects that match their skills and interests. Technical Approach: The project uses a "No-Build" architecture with Vanilla JS, HTML5, and CSS3 for zero dependencies and instant performance. It utilizes Vercel Edge Functions to proxy the GitHub API, providing live stats like stars, forks, and "Good First Issues" without hitting rate limits. Its clean, modular structure makes it an ideal project for GSSoC contributors to build features like comparison modes, advanced filtering, and real-time data updates.

projects.title: LegalEase

projects.title: Checkora
projects.desc: Checkora is an open-source chess platform where players can compete against an AI opponent powered by minimax search with alpha-beta pruning. The backend is built on Django and the AI engine is written in C++, communicating via a clean REST API. The frontend is a pure JS/HTML board with real-time move validation, promotion handling, and game state management. Contributors can work across three layers the Django backend, the C++ engine, or the frontend UI making it accessible to beginners and advanced devs alike. We are adding CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions workflows, and issue templates to make onboarding smooth for GSSoC contributors.

projects.title: Achievement Management System
projects.desc: A centralized platform for tracking and showcasing academic achievements. Students access their accomplishments instantly. Teachers record them effortlessly. Everyone gets clarity.

projects.title: Sketchbook UI
projects.desc: Sketchbook UI is a React component library meant to help developers quickly build interfaces that feel hand-drawn (sketchy borders, paper textures, pencil-like details) so their side projects or landing pages don’t look like the same standard UI kit; it’s for React/TypeScript users who want a distinctive aesthetic with good DX, and technically it delivers this as fully typed TS components plus a provider-based theming setup (colors/typography) and a bundled library stylesheet, built with a modern library pipeline (TS + Vite) that outputs ESM/CJS and supports tree-shaking with React as a peer dependency.

projects.title: Eagle:-Real-Time Semantic Surveillance using Detection + Tracking + Reasoning
projects.desc: Eagle is an open-source, production-grade surveillance AI system that transcends traditional computer vision. Instead of merely identifying objects ("Person detected"), it performs multi-modal temporal reasoning to infer intent and behavior: "A person is loitering near the restricted exit and repeatedly looking at the keypad." Core Value Proposition: Traditional CV detects → Agentic Vision understands. It fuses YOLO-based perception, ByteTrack identity tracking, Redis temporal memory, and a Vision-Language Model (VLM) reasoning layer into a single agentic pipeline. -> What Makes This "2026-Level"? - Zero-shot behavior detection — no explicit training required for every behavior type - Temporal semantic reasoning across 10–30 second activity windows Natural language explanations instead of raw alert codes - Agentic decision loop: perceive → remember → reason → alert → adapt - Human-in-the-loop feedback for continuous model improvement

projects.title: NowBind
projects.desc: NowBind is an open-source alternative to Medium, Ghost and Substack, built for the AI-agent era - with native MCP feed support so your content is instantly consumable by any LLM or AI workflow.

projects.title: ReadmeForge
projects.desc: ReadmeForge is a lightweight, browser-based tool that helps developers create clean and professional GitHub README files without needing to write Markdown manually. It provides a structured, section-based interface where users can input project details, preview the output in real time, and export ready-to-use Markdown instantly. The project is designed to be beginner-friendly and open for contributions, with a focus on improving documentation quality in open-source projects. Contributors can work on features like UI improvements, new templates, export options, and better customization. The goal is to make README creation fast, simple, and accessible for every developer.

projects.title: Employee Leave Management system
projects.desc: A full-stack web application for managing employee leaves and reimbursement claims with role-based access control.

projects.title: ChaatBazaar
projects.desc: ChaatBazaar is an interactive web platform that lets users explore the best street foods from different states of India. Many authentic Indian street foods remain unknown to people outside their home regions, partly due to Foreign or Global food Influence. ChaatBazaar bridges this gap by giving users the opportunity to discover and enjoy India’s traditional local delicacies from across the country. The website features a curated menu showcasing popular snacks like Samosa, Kachori, Panipuri, and many other Local tasty dishes, that still haven't got recognition in the country. The platform features a modern, responsive UI, search and filter functionality, cart management, and newsletter subscriptions. projects.title: leet-journal
projects.desc: Its a companion app for Interview Preparation offering a Leetcode type platform for students and also for organizations who can use this in their premises as a on-prem software for learning and testing. projects.title: Codevibe
projects.desc: CodeVibe is a coding platform where users can practice programming in a structured and easy way. Right now, the platform mainly focuses on web development, where users get tasks to complete and improve their skills step by step. It tracks progress, gives points on completing tasks, and at the end provides certificates and feedback based on performance. The idea is inspired by freeCodeCamp. There is strictness in following the given instructions—only code that matches the required guidelines gets accepted. projects.title: Kerno – eBPF-based Kernel Observability Engine
projects.desc: Kerno is an eBPF-powered kernel observability engine designed to simplify debugging and performance monitoring on Linux systems. It provides real-time insights into system behavior by tracing syscall latency, TCP/network flows, OOM events, disk I/O, scheduler delays, and file descriptor leaks. Unlike traditional tools, Kerno requires zero configuration and presents findings in human-readable format, making kernel-level debugging accessible even to beginners. The project focuses on bridging the gap between complex Linux internals and developer-friendly observability. During GSSoC, contributors will work on expanding tracing capabilities, improving CLI experience, enhancing documentation, and optionally building a visualization dashboard.

projects.title: Conn

It features sophisticated 3D tilt-responsive cards, dynamic aurora animations, glassmorphism, and magnetic cursor effects that provide an immediate 'wow-factor'. Behind the stunning front-end lies a secure, authenticated backend and a powerful admin dashboard. Users gain intuitive control over their digital identities, effortlessly managing links, profiles, and deep customizations. projects.title: Humane-Proxy
projects.desc: HumaneProxy is a lightweight, privacy-first AI safety middleware designed to protect humans. While most AI safety tools focus on preventing prompt injections, HumaneProxy specifically detects and intercepts self-harm ideation and criminal intent before the message reaches the upstream LLM. Technical Approach: It operates as a plug-and-play reverse proxy and MCP server using a highly efficient 3-stage cascading pipeline: 1. Heuristics & Regex (instant blocking) 2. Semantic Embeddings (sentence-transformers) 3. Reasoning LLMs (LlamaGuard/OpenAI). It features exponential time-decay risk tracking, webhook alerts, and native LangChain/LlamaIndex and other integrations. It is AAA rated on Glama MCP marketplace and is actively in development. Who is it for: AI developers and enterprises wanting to add production-grade trust & safety guardrails to mitigate societal damage risks with their AI agents without altering their core LLM logic or compromising user privacy.

Smart Configuration: Dynamic rulesets including negative marking, difficulty scaling, and PDF-to-exam parsing. projects.title: Logara AI
projects.desc: Logara AI is an AI-powered log intelligence platform designed to automate log analysis, anomaly detection, and root cause identification in modern distributed systems. Developers and DevOps engineers often struggle with massive volumes of logs, making debugging slow and inefficient. This project solves that by using AI and semantic search to detect unusual patterns, summarize logs, and provide actionable insights with suggested fixes. It is built for developers, backend engineers, DevOps teams, and students working with scalable systems. The platform integrates real-time log ingestion, embedding-based semantic search, and LLM-driven analysis to detect anomalies and generate contextual insights. It is designed with a scalable microservices architecture, async processing pipelines, and developer-friendly APIs, along with an interactive dashboard for monitoring and visualization. Additionally, Logara AI emphasizes explainable AI by providing interpretable insights and actionable debugging suggestions, helping developers resolve issues faster rather than just analyzing logs.

projects.title: Zentrix
projects.desc: Zentrix is a powerful developer-first platform designed to unify and simplify how you interact with AI by allowing you to bring your own AI models and APIs into one seamless environment. Instead of being limited to a single provider, you can run multiple models across text, images, audio, and other modalities, compare their outputs side-by-side, and experiment freely from a single interface. Built for developers and innovators, Zentrix goes beyond simple API usage by providing a playground to test, evaluate, and orchestrate AI workflows, enabling you to chain models, analyze performance, and build intelligent pipelines tailored to your needs. With full control over your APIs, costs, and configurations, Zentrix eliminates vendor lock-in and acts as a central hub for exploring, comparing, and building with AI without limits.

projects.title: openCSE

projects.title: Schedula- A Appointment Booking Web Application

The project solves common booking problems such as fake slot availability, delayed confirmations, hidden pricing, and difficult rescheduling processes. Users can discover services, check real-time slot availability, book appointments, make secure payments, reschedule or cancel bookings, and leave reviews. The platform supports customers, organisers, and admins with dedicated dashboards and workflows. The project uses React.js, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express.js, MySQL, and Razorpay integration. Features include secure authentication, real-time slot validation, payment verification, role-based access control, subscription plans, multilingual support, analytics dashboards, and responsive UI. The repository is beginner-friendly and prepared for open-source contributions with contribution guidelines, issue templates, pull request templates, documentation structure, and good first issues.

projects.title: WorktoWords

It includes features like tone customization, content suggestions, hashtag optimization, best posting time insights, and a history dashboard to track and reuse past content. Built with a modular service architecture, it integrates intelligent AI generation with user preferences to deliver consistent, personalized content while maintaining a clean, scalable SaaS experience.

projects.title: urBackend - From Clicks to Secure APIs in seconds.
projects.desc: urBackend is an open-source, MongoDB-native Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) platform that gives frontend developers instant REST APIs for database, authentication, file storage, transactional mail, and real-time features - without writing a single line of backend code. Unlike Firebase (closed-source, vendor lock-in) or Supabase (Postgres-only), urBackend is built specifically for the MongoDB ecosystem. Its core philosophy is BYOK (Bring Your Own Keys) - developers can connect their own MongoDB Atlas cluster, and S3/Cloudflare R2 storage bucket — with Resend mail, FCM push, and SMS integrations actively in development. The project is actively maintained with weekly releases (v0.4 → v0.6 shipped in one week), a live production API at api.ub.bitbros.in and live at https://urbackend.bitbros.in, an official TypeScript SDK on npm (@urbackend/sdk), and a growing contributor base across TypeScript, Java, and Python. For GSSoC contributors, urBackend offers a wide range of meaningful tasks across the full stack: • Backend (Node.js/Express) - new API features, security improvements, webhook system • Frontend (React/Vite) - dashboard UI, schema builder, analytics visualizations • SDK (TypeScript) - expanding @urbackend/sdk with React hooks, new methods • Java SDK - building urBackend client library for Android and Spring Boot developers (Future Scope ) • Python — analytics microservice, data pipeline for usage insights(Future) • Documentation — API reference, guides, getting started tutorials • Testing — integration test suite for production endpoints Contributors will work on a real, production-deployed product used by developers - not a toy project. Every merged PR ships to actual users. urBackend is MIT licensed, open source on GitHub, and welcomes contributors of all experience levels — from first-time open source contributors to experienced developers looking to build meaningful features.

projects.title: reframe

projects.title: iloveAgents

Built using Python (Flask/FastAPI), OpenCV, and modern web technologies, the platform integrates AI, voice systems, and web interfaces to create an intelligent, assistive mobility solution.

projects.title: Harmonic-Resonance-Forest

projects.title: SQL-Based Data Warehouse for Retail Analytics with BI Integration
projects.desc: This project addresses the challenge of transforming raw, inconsistent data from sources like CRM and ERP systems into a structured and reliable format suitable for analytics. It is designed for business analysts, data analysts, and organizations that need accurate insights from retail sales data, as well as for learners aiming to understand real-world data engineering workflows. The technical approach follows the Medallion Architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold), where raw data is first ingested into the Bronze layer, then cleaned, standardized, and validated in the Silver layer using SQL transformations, and finally modeled into a star schema in the Gold layer for efficient querying. The pipeline is implemented using SQL-based ETL processes and is connected to Power BI to generate interactive dashboards, enabling data-driven decision-making.
